import trimesh, numpy as np, glob
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
ms={}
for f in glob.glob('checks/assembly/model.assembly.*.stl'):
    m=trimesh.load(f); ms[round(m.volume)]=m
box=[m for v,m in ms.items() if v>30000][0]; lid=[m for v,m in ms.items() if 15000<v<25000][0]
lf=lid.copy(); v=lf.vertices.copy(); v[:,1]=112-v[:,1]; v[:,2]=40-v[:,2]; lf.vertices=v
# sample points on surfaces
pa,_=trimesh.sample.sample_surface(box,200000); pb,_=trimesh.sample.sample_surface(lf,200000)
t=cKDTree(pb); d,i=t.query(pa)
k=np.argsort(d)[:12]
for j in k: print('gap',round(float(d[j]),3),'boxpt',np.round(pa[j],2),'lidpt',np.round(pb[i[j]],2))
